NVIDIA GA10B

GA10B
NVIDIA's GA10B GPU uses the Ampere architecture and is made using a 8 nm production process at Samsung. With a die size of 200 mm² it is an average sized chip. GA10B supports DirectX 12 Ultimate (Feature Level 12_2). It also supports OpenGL 4.6 and Vulkan 1.4. For GPU compute applications, OpenCL version 3.0 and CUDA 8.7 can be used. Additionally, the DirectX 12 Ultimate capability guarantees support for hardware-raytracing, variable-rate shading and more, in upcoming video games. It features 2048 shading units, 64 texture mapping units and 32 ROPs. Also included are 64 Tensor Cores which help improve the speed of machine learning applications with support for the INT4 and INT8 data formats. The GPU also contains 12 raytracing acceleration cores.
Further reading: Ampere Architecture Whitepaper
